item: Resolution of the manufacturing slack-versus-scarcity conflict (open conflict f)
queries_tried: Ledger query: grep of evidence.jsonl for bottleneck B6 across all agents (72 G-records, 12 C-records, 1 D-record); cross-read of Agent G report sections 1.1-1.12, 4.1-4.2 and 5.2, Agent C section 2 B6 and section 6.3, Agent D section 4b, Agent R grade_summary sections 6(f) and 7(2); comparison of E-3036 against E-6005/E-6006/E-6008/E-6019/E-6070/E-3037; check of every B6 record for a disclosed utilisation figure or booking lead time with a named denominator
failure_reason: No record in the ledger carries a disclosed CDMO utilisation rate with a stated denominator except Samsung Biologics' plain-language 'full utilization' statement (E-6003, graded 하). Every saturation multiple derives from an invented lead-time-to-utilisation mapping with no cited empirical basis (E-6070, 하). W does not collect new evidence, so the conflict cannot be closed from inside the ledger.
alt_sources_tried: 1) Agent G's own UNRESOLVED items 6 and 7, which record the same wall for aseptic fill-finish and ADC conjugation. 2) Agent C's E-3036 viral-vector supply model, which is 중 but covers suites rather than shared inputs. 3) Agent D's E-9030 baseline utilisations, which are proxies inherited from G. 4) Agent R's re-access record, which upheld 하 on nine of ten component multiples. 5) The openFDA CRL cohort (E-6022/E-6074), which is survivorship-selected by construction.
best_estimate: Manufacturing delays approvals rather than preventing them at system level, with an elasticity on annual approvals of order 0.05; the exception is autologous cell therapy, where one batch equals one dose and elasticity on patients treated approaches 1.0. The saturation rank order (shared inputs before modality-specific steps) is plausibly right; the multiples are not measurements.
best_estimate_basis: E-6074 (중) is the best-evidenced record in the area and states the delay-not-prevent finding directly; E-6075 (하) computes the 0.05 elasticity; E-6063 (중) carries the one-batch-one-dose arithmetic; E-3036 (중) is the only Medium-grade capacity record and it says slack. The report carries the conflict open rather than adopting either side.

item: A reconciliation of the four AI clinical-molecule counts (29 / 75 / 117 / ~175) under one inclusion rule
queries_tried: Ledger query for every record whose claim contains an AI-molecule count: E-9007, E-2054, E-2055, E-2071, E-2072, E-2007, E-9516, E-9517; cross-read of Agent B sections 5 and 7, Agent X finding X-08, Agent R grade_summary section 6(h); check of each record's figures.denominator_def field for a stated inclusion criterion
failure_reason: No record states an operational definition of 'AI-derived'. E-2054 (하) explicitly warns that aggregated counts mix candidates for which AI proposed target and structure with programmes where AI merely accelerated screening or trial design. The ~175 figure is an unrecorded search hit with no ledger record at all.
alt_sources_tried: 1) E-2007 (중), Niazi's independent count of 4-9 molecules with publicly documented clinical outcomes, which is a fifth incompatible number on a stricter rule. 2) E-2056 (중), FDA IND receipts, which carries no AI provenance field. 3) Agent B UNRESOLVED item 9, which records that no regulator tags INDs by discovery method. 4) Agent X UNRESOLVED X-U1, seeking a regulator-sourced series.
best_estimate: 29 on a conservative regulator-adjacent count; 117 on the broad 'AI-enabled' definition; 4-9 on the strictest 'publicly documented clinical outcome' rule. The report names the counting rule at every use and gives no single reconciled figure.
best_estimate_basis: E-9007 (중) is the highest-graded count and the most conservative; E-2054 (하) is the broadest and its own authors state the inclusion rule is mixed; E-2007 (중) is the strictest. A reconciliation would require the underlying company lists, which none of the three sources publishes.

item: Resolution of the enrolment-direction contradiction inside Agent F's own block (open conflict j)
queries_tried: Ledger query for E-5001, E-5002, E-5003, E-5004, E-5010, E-5026, E-5065; cross-read of Agent F sections 1 and 'Cross-check against my own bias'; check of E-5026's figures.sample field for the benchmarking cohort definition; comparison of the registry series denominator against the sponsor-contributed denominator
failure_reason: Both sides grade 중 and neither carries a sample definition that would let the two be placed on a common denominator. E-5026's cohort is sponsor-contributed and its 'planned' baseline is sponsor-set and revisable; the registry series measures elapsed calendar time against a fixed clock. No record measures both on the same trials.
alt_sources_tried: 1) E-5010 (중), which finds roughly one in five trials completing within the planned timeframe and a 12.2-month median delay, and which sits with the registry side. 2) E-5007 (중) and E-5009 (중) on accrual-driven termination, which also sit with the registry side. 3) E-9524 (하) and E-9525 (중), independent workforce and trial-start series, which point the same way as the registry side but do not measure enrolment against plan.
best_estimate: The registry series is the better measure of system capacity because its clock is fixed and its denominator is not sponsor-selected; the benchmarking series is most plausibly explained by selection into the sample. This is a hypothesis, not a resolution, and the report states it as such.
best_estimate_basis: Three independent Medium-grade records (E-5010, E-5007, E-5009) point the same direction as the registry series and none supports the benchmarking direction. Agent F recorded the tension without resolving it in its own favour, and Agent R left the conflict open.

item: Which UK Biobank proteomics cohort each of the two conflicting records refers to (open conflict, surfaced by Agent R)
queries_tried: Ledger query for E-8124 and E-9549; comparison of their claim text, figures blocks, provenance_hops and published_date; check for any third record in the ledger citing the same paper; cross-read of Agent I follow-up F.4 and Agent R grade_summary section 5 addendum
failure_reason: Neither record names its cohort. Both are plausible for different cohorts inside the same study - the full phase versus the randomised discovery subcohort - and W collects no new evidence, so the paper cannot be re-opened to adjudicate.
alt_sources_tried: 1) E-8125 (중), the proteome-wide MR applications record, which cites the resource without giving a participant count. 2) E-8009 (중), the Phase II enrichment test, which uses a different dataset entirely. 3) E-3100 (중) and E-9507 (중), the genetic-support records, which are a separate resource. No fourth record in the ledger carries a UK Biobank proteomics participant count.
best_estimate: Both figures are recorded as they stand and neither is quoted without the statement that its cohort is unnamed. The larger figure (54,306 profiled / 50,395 in the GWAS) is most consistent with a full-phase description and the smaller (34,557) with a discovery subcohort.
best_estimate_basis: E-8124 (중) and E-9549 (중) are both Medium and neither is preferred. Under measurement protocol M3 an unnamed denominator caps confidence, and the report applies that cap rather than choosing.

item: A measured elasticity of annual approvals - or of health outcome - to any single pipeline factor, to replace the judgement-based scenario probabilities in section 5
queries_tried: Ledger query across all 774 records for type 'derived' with an approvals-elasticity metric; review of E-3080 through E-3096 (Agent C's constructed elasticities), E-9037 and E-9038 (Agent D's tornado and single-lever runs), E-6075 (Agent G), E-7106 (Agent H); check of Agent C UNRESOLVED U-2 and Agent X UNRESOLVED X-U3
failure_reason: Agent C recorded explicitly that no published elasticity of annual approvals to any pipeline factor exists, which is why M2 required construction. Agent X recorded that no published elasticity of health outcome exists either. Every elasticity in the run is therefore an analyst construction, and the two independent constructions that agree were partly calibrated to one another.
alt_sources_tried: 1) Agent D's tornado (E-9037, 하), which sweeps 26 parameters but against a modelled rather than an observed output series. 2) Agent H's decision-tool exchange rate (E-7106, 중), which is an elasticity of screening burden rather than of approvals. 3) Agent G's channel decomposition (E-6075, 하). 4) The natural experiments that do exist - FDA review time 1983-2017 (E-1029, 중) and the genomics expansion (E-9505, 중) - which bound direction but not magnitude.
best_estimate: The scenario probabilities in section 5 are the report's own judgement, marked [INFER], conditioned on named Medium-grade anchors, and explicitly not measurements. Their most defensible content is the ordering and the direction of change between horizons, not the point values.
best_estimate_basis: E-3080 (하) states the construction; E-9038 (하) and E-3113 (하) show two constructions agreeing on single levers from different stage probabilities, which is a genuine check, while the joint agreement is calibrated and therefore not independent (E-9024, 하).
